rationale: Timeline 2 is the timeline containing the incident, so it is selected instead of the latest timeline 3, which is an abandoned recovery drill. The target is the named restore point before_batch_cleanup at LSN 0/C120000 because RP-880 and TX-881 share the reported timestamp, making a timestamp target ambiguous. Recovery replays WAL from the base backup through segment 00000002000000000000000C on timeline 2 and stops with recovery_target_action=pause at the named target. The restore is performed only into the isolated offline drill environment; no production restore, promotion, client routing or external notification is performed, and promotion remains a manual review step.
